title: Surreal Cosmic Reading Scene
description: A skeletal figure in a colorful robe and headdress sits reading a book beside a stream in a vibrant fantasy landscape. A massive glowing lotus-like portal with orbiting planets and rings floats in the sky above, emitting golden light rays, while papers fly through the air near a treehouse and windmill.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy scene featuring a skeletal figure wearing a blue and orange robe with a spiky headdress, sitting on the grass reading a large book by a stream with a small wooden boat. A massive dark blue lotus-shaped cosmic portal with glowing orange edges and multiple orbiting planets and rings floats in the sky, emitting bright golden light beams. In the background there is a treehouse connected by a rope bridge to a purple cliff, a windmill on a distant hill, lush green trees, flying papers and crescent moons swirling in the air, under a dramatic colorful nebula sky with stars.
